pages.text: Read this before you step through any portal. Every dimension has its own mechanical modifiers on top of mob scaling, and walking in unprepared is the most reliable way to die here.

pages.title: Tier 1 and 2 Dimensions
pages.text: $(bold)Overworld$(): the baseline.$(br2)$(bold)Twilight Forest$(): a persistent Darkness debuff underground. Bosses guard the progression: you cannot reach a later zone without defeating the bosses of the zones before it.$(br2)$(bold)Blue Skies$(): elemental damage ignores standard armor, so magic resistance (Sorcery tree) is worth more here than usual.

pages.title: Tier 3 Dimensions
pages.text: $(bold)Undergarden$(): constant Poison I. Every mob inflicts Wither on hit (1s). Healing items are 25% less effective.$(br2)$(bold)Deeper & Darker$(): noise detection (KubeJS). Mob aggro radius scales with your armor's sound; sprint-walking in full iron is very loud.$(br2)$(bold)Nether$(): every mob starts aggro'd, there are no ambient neutral mobs, and lava deals 50% more damage.

pages.title: Tier 4 Dimensions
pages.text: $(bold)The Aether$() (Deep Aether's biomes included): thin air above y 180 brings Weakness unless your armour carries Aether Acclimation. Sprinting above y 200 brings vertigo, and one updraft slows a fall into the void. Its mobs move fast.

pages.title: Tier 4 Dimensions, cont.
pages.text: $(bold)The End$(): three escalating zones. The Outer Islands are manageable. The Deep End has elite mobs and Void environmental damage. Dragon's Domain is the endgame, and the Ender Dragon scales up with each kill.$(br2)$(bold)Next: $(l:icraft:systems/enchantments)Custom Enchantments$(/l) has a counter for most of these.$()
